name: Persistent Systems Ltd
about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration [1] . It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS [2] .

business.what: Persistent Systems is an IT services and digital engineering company serving global enterprises with software engineering, product development and AI-led services. It earns revenue from client projects and engineering work, booked as multi-year contract value. It is also acquiring Nagarro.

segments.name: Software, High-Tech and Emerging industries (vertical)
segments.comment: Fastest-growing vertical at 28.5% YoY, driven by the new Software Reinvention offering.

segments.name: Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (vertical)
segments.comment: Grew 16.2% YoY, a solid contributor to overall growth.

segments.name: Healthcare and Life Sciences (vertical)
segments.comment: Grew 12% YoY, the slowest of the three named verticals.

segments.name: North America (geography)
segments.comment: Revenue grew 22.5% YoY in USD, a strong performance.

segments.name: Europe (geography)
segments.comment: Declined 8.5% YoY due to two client-specific, one-off events.

segments.name: Rest of the world (geography)
segments.comment: Grew 67% YoY, but on a much smaller base.

ledger.promise: $2 billion annual revenue (run rate) by March 2027
ledger.quote: we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027
ledger.actual: Quarterly revenue rose from 4,056 (Q4 FY26) to 4,303 and 4,664 (Q2 FY27); 4,664 annualised is 18,656. No FX rate in the materials to convert this to USD.

ledger.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
ledger.actual: FY26 PBT 2,411 (sum of quarters), PAT 1,865, so implied tax of 546 and ETR of about 22.6%, inside the range.

ledger.promise: A further, unquantified cost reduction in FY27
ledger.quote: There will be a further reduction in cost that will happen in FY27.
ledger.actual: No cost breakdown provided. EBITDA margin fell from 18.9% (Q4 FY26) to 16.2% (Q1 FY27) and 13.6% (Q2 FY27), which does not show savings.

ledger.promise: OCF to PAT recovers in Q1 FY27 from 77% in Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: which we expect to normalize in the next quarter.
ledger.actual: No quarterly cash flow data, and later calls in the materials don't report it. Full-year FY26 OCF of 1,767 was 95% of PAT (1,865).

ledger.promise: EBIT margin aspiration of 16-17% (described as aspiration, not guidance)
ledger.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin was 13.6%, so EBIT is lower still. Q2 FY27 call restated it as an aspiration 'over a period of time', without a date.

ledger.promise: AI-enabled delivery to be margin neutral or accretive
ledger.quote: most of these things should be margin neutral or accretive because if we use technology, we should be able to do more work with lesser people
ledger.actual: No AI-specific margin data. Company EBITDA margin fell from 18.9% (Q4 FY26) to 13.6% (Q2 FY27).

ledger.promise: Large net new deal ($125M+ a year) accretive to revenue and margin from Q2
ledger.quote: And yes, it will be accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards.
ledger.actual: No deal-level data. In Q2 FY27, revenue grew 8.4% QoQ, but EBITDA fell from 697 to 633 and margin from 16.2% to 13.6%.

ledger.promise: Persistent standalone continues to grow in FY27
ledger.quote: we are confident despite the cannibalization, we will continue to grow. And as I said, even the large deal cements the growth for Persistent for this year.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue was 8,967 against 6,915 in H1 FY26 (+29.7%). H1 PAT was 835 against 896 (-6.8%).

ledger.promise: Nagarro deal to close in Q4 CY2026 or early Q1 CY2027
ledger.quote: we expect this transaction to close sometime towards the Q4 of Calendar Year 2026 or early Q1 of Calendar Year 2027.
ledger.actual: Repeated on the Q2 FY27 call. RBI and Austria/Spain FDI approvals expected within 4-8 weeks of that call. Not closed as of the materials.

ledger.promise: Nagarro deal to be cash EPS and reported EPS accretive in Year 1, excluding transaction expenses
ledger.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses
ledger.actual: Deal not closed. Q2 FY27 call added a $450M equity raise, which the Q1 debt-funded maths did not include. Q2 FY27 transaction costs cut reported EPS by about 3.1%.

ledger.promise: Net debt/combined EBITDA of 1.9-2.5x at closing, falling to 1x by FY2030
ledger.quote: The leverage, that is the Net Debt over the combined EBITDA, is going to be 1.9 times-2.5 times based on how much will be the open offer
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 call changed funding to a $1.25B debt-plus-equity raise ($450M equity) replacing the €1.4B bridge. FY27 borrowings were 575, so acquisition debt not yet drawn.

ledger.quote: laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031
ledger.actual: Repeated on the Q1 FY27 call, now including Nagarro. TTM revenue is 16,801; no FX rate in the materials to convert.

current_guidance.quote: the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.
Do we need additional verticals to scale to the aspiration of $5 billion that we have? By FY31, we get that as well at a nice scale.

current_guidance.horizon: Over a period of time (no date)
current_guidance.quote: deliver to our aspirational goals of 16 to 17% margins and the growth that we aspire.

current_guidance.target: $1.25B raise, of which $450M through equity, QIP or equity-linked instruments; replaces €1.4B 18-month bridge
current_guidance.horizon: Ahead of / linked to deal closure
current_guidance.quote: we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity. Out of this, USD 450 million will be raised through equity

current_guidance.target: About $50M in total; a further $25-30M still to come
current_guidance.horizon: Next two quarters (p9) or next 3-4 quarters (p23); the call gives both
current_guidance.quote: we are expecting one-time expenses to the tune of approximately $50 million spread over three to four quarters.

current_guidance.target: Close in Q4 CY26 or Q1 CY27; RBI and Austria/Spain FDI approvals within 4-8 weeks
current_guidance.quote: We expect the deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.

current_guidance.target: Cash and reported EPS accretive in Year 1, excluding transaction expenses
current_guidance.quote: become cash EPS accretive from Year 1, and remove the transactional expenses, even the reported EPS should be positive from Year 1.

current_guidance.metric: Margin drag from tools/licence amortisation (about 90 bps)
current_guidance.quote: As we optimize the spend and our revenue scales in future, the impact on our margins will gradually reduce.
I stand by the comments I made earlier, healthcare should start seeing growth.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: The FY26 tax guide was met (implied ETR about 22.6%), and the revenue promises are tracking, with H1 FY27 revenue up 29.7% YoY. Profit and margin claims have not held: EBITDA margin fell from 18.9% to 13.6% over two quarters while the 16-17% EBIT aspiration and a margin-accretive large deal were being restated, and the Nagarro funding plan changed to include $450M of equity. Most of the deal-related promises cannot be checked yet.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: EBIT margin aspiration of 16-17%, repeated as recently as the Q2 FY27 call
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin went from 18.9% (Q4 FY26) to 16.2% (Q1 FY27) to 13.6% (Q2 FY27). EBIT is below EBITDA, so Q2 EBIT margin was under 13.6%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The large net new deal would add to revenue and margin from Q2 FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 8.4% QoQ (4,303 to 4,664), but EBITDA fell from 697 to 633 and PAT from 483 to 352. Management attributes part of this to about 90 bps of tools amortisation and Nagarro costs.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q3 FY26 EBIT took a 180 bps wage-hike headwind plus a one-time 230 bps labour code charge
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Reported EBITDA margin actually rose from 19.1% to 19.4% in Q3 FY26. PBT fell from 617 to 565 and PAT from 471 to 439, so the one-time charge seems to sit below EBITDA in this data.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Weak Q4 FY26 OCF/PAT (77%) was due to unbilled revenue timing and would normalise
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Debtor days rose from 62 (FY24) to 82 (FY25) and 83 (FY26), so the working-capital build has lasted more than one quarter. Full-year FY26 OCF/PAT was still 95% (1,767/1,865).

bull.point: Revenue growth is strong and speeding up
bull.evidence: FY26 revenue was 14,748 (+23.5% YoY). Q2 FY27 revenue was 4,664, up 30.2% YoY and 8.4% QoQ. H1 FY27 was up 29.7%.

bull.point: A large multi-year contract supports near-term revenue
bull.evidence: The net new deal adds roughly $125M+ a year and $650M+ over 6.5 years. Management says it 'cements the growth for Persistent for this year'.

bull.point: Cash generation and tax guidance held up in FY26
bull.evidence: FY26 OCF was 1,767, against 1,157 in FY25 (+53%). FY26 implied ETR was about 22.6%, inside the 20-24% guide.

bear.point: Profitability is falling while revenue grows
bear.evidence: EBITDA margin went from 19.4% (Q3 FY26) to 13.6% (Q2 FY27). Q2 FY27 PAT was 352, down 25% YoY from 471. TTM PAT of 1,803 is below FY26's 1,865.

bear.point: Nagarro funding now includes equity dilution, which the Q1 accretion case did not assume
bear.evidence: Q1 presented a €1.4B bridge at about 4.1-4.8% with EPS accretion in Year 1. Q2 announced a $1.25B raise, of which $450M is equity, QIP or equity-linked.

bear.point: Deal costs are large, the timing is inconsistent, and integration value will take time
bear.evidence: About $50M in one-time costs, which cut Q2 reported EPS by about 3.1%. The remaining $25-30M is said to come over 'two quarters' (p9) and over '3 to 4 quarters' (p23). Management calls integration a 'slow roll'.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call p9, p23; Q1 FY27 call p10
